title: Core local representative theorem
statement: For a scheme morphism g:T→S and set sheaf F on S_et [lem-weil-pbc-sets-etale-inverse-image-composition-units], every section of g⁻¹F over T has, on an étale cover indexed in Type u, representatives in the presheaf left Kan extension of F along opposite base change.

source.place: Lemma Tag 09XN (lemma-describe-pullback), proof, paragraph beginning 'By construction of g_{i, small}^{-1}G'

proof.text: Unfold g⁻¹F as sheafification aP. Mathlib Presheaf.isLocallySurjective_toSheafify and imageSieve_mem show that arrows on which s has a P-representative form a covering sieve. Scheme.mem_smallGrothendieckTopology extracts an étale Cover with index in Type u whose presieve lies in that sieve. Use its objects and maps as Z and π; Sieve.le_generate makes this family covering, and image-sieve membership supplies each p and its equation.
